skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the basic concepts and contents related to Vietnamese language, including phonetics, vocabulary, grammar, and text structures.
Apply theoretical knowledge to practical exercises in Vietnamese language.
Demonstrate active participation in group work, presentations, and discussions.
Analyze and compare Vietnamese language with other languages, particularly English.
Effectively communicate and present findings in Vietnamese language.
Conduct research, write reports, and summarize texts in Vietnamese.
Identify and correct errors in Vietnamese language usage, including spelling, grammar, and text composition.
Prepare and deliver presentations on Vietnamese language topics.
Analyze and summarize literature in Vietnamese.
Write coherent and structured texts in Vietnamese.
